purpose: Teach: 公債/渡航/出国/通院/含有/取り扱っ/照会/婚姻

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、公債絡みの詐欺を捜査しております
lines.en: We're investigating a case involving government bond fraud.
lines.style: Even, professional opening. Measured pace. The calm authority of someone who has said this many times. No performance—just fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の海外渡航を警察、阻止されたんですね
lines.en: Yes. So the police managed to prevent the suspect from leaving the country.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with a slight uptick of interest. Following Officer Takeda's lead. Careful not to overstep—this is his domain.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、出国停止命令を発令いたしました
lines.en: We issued a departure ban order.
lines.style: Straightforward, procedural. No inflection needed—the action speaks for itself. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者の通院支援、警察、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We really appreciate the support the police have provided for the victim's medical care.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, not forced. Respectful nod of recognition in the voice. Warm but not overly familiar.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の含有物質を分析中です
lines.en: We're currently analyzing the chemical composition of the seized items.
lines.style: Methodical, unhurried. The tone of someone working through evidence with proper care. Slightly technical—detail matters here.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠物を警察、慎重に取り扱っておられますね
lines.en: Yes. The police are handling the evidence with real care and precision.
lines.style: Observant respect. He's noticing the thoroughness. Quiet affirmation—not praise, but recognition of a job being done right.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民からの照会窓口を強化しました
lines.en: We've strengthened our inquiry desk for citizen reports.
lines.style: Brief, informative. The tone of an update being delivered efficiently. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。偽装婚姻の取り締まりも進めておられますね
lines.en: Yes. And you're moving forward on the sham marriage cases too, I see.
lines.style: Observant, slightly warmer. He's tracking multiple threads—shows he's been listening closely. Still deferential, but the comment carries an undertone of genuine interest.
